name: Desco Infratech Ltd
tagline: Rs 163 Cr microcap CGD / pipeline-infrastructure EPC-services contractor that grew FY26 revenue ~99% to ~Rs 119 Cr, near-debt-free with 25% ROE, and is diversifying into compressed bio-gas (5 TPD Bulandshahr plant, Phase-1 live Jun 2026) and the UAE - order book ~Rs 345 Cr (~3x revenue) + a ~Rs 650 Cr tender pipeline
business_overview: Desco Infratech (incorporated 2011, NSE-listed) is an engineering, planning and construction contractor for city gas distribution (CGD) networks - steel and MDPE pipeline laying, house-service connections, station work - and has extended into renewable/water/power infra and now compressed bio-gas (CBG) via subsidiary Shri Green Agro Energies. Sovrenn Daily News seed (2026-09-02); Sovrenn trigger: 2026-06-25 commissioning of Phase-1 of a 5 TPD CBG plant at Bulandshahr, UP (initial ~1 TPD, commercial sales imminent). No dedicated ValuePickr thread - forum search returned nothing; this is a web/filings/news-only read.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 163 Cr; ROE ~25.5%; promoter ~58.3%; roughly flat over 1 year
PAT ~Rs 16.4 Cr; annual revenue growth ~102% on a trailing basis
~Rs 345+ Cr (~3x FY26 revenue); tender pipeline ~Rs 650 Cr at a 30-40% conversion assumption; 18-24 month execution visibility
CBG Phase-1 (5 TPD, Bulandshahr) commissioned Jun 2026; commercial CBG sales starting; UAE subsidiary; recent orders from Adani Total Gas, KP Energy
fundamentals_narrative: The trailing 3-5 year average is thin - this is a tiny EPC-services contractor - but the recent inflection is real and specific: FY26 revenue roughly doubled, the balance sheet is essentially net-cash, ROE is ~25%, and the disclosed order book (~Rs 345 Cr) is about 3x FY26 revenue with a further ~Rs 650 Cr of tenders. The CBG move is a genuine step up the value chain (asset ownership and recurring off-take vs one-off contract revenue) rather than another low-margin service line, and Phase-1 is now physically commissioned. Against that: CGD-pipeline EPC is a low-moat, tender-driven, working-capital-heavy activity with large customer concentration (gas utilities), the CBG contribution is not yet material, and the stock is a sub-Rs 200 Cr SME with the liquidity and disclosure limits that implies.
technical_read: Not pulled. Roughly flat over the last year despite the earnings jump; thin SME float.
sentiment_summary: No ValuePickr thread. Web/filings/news only: FY26 results (revenue ~Rs 119 Cr +99%, PAT ~Rs 16.4 Cr), the Bulandshahr CBG Phase-1 commissioning press release, the ~Rs 345 Cr order-book / ~Rs 650 Cr pipeline disclosure from the May 2026 investor call, a UAE subsidiary, and a run of small pipeline/cable work orders from Adani Total Gas and KP Energy.
community_signal: None available - no forum thread, no trusted-user coverage.
bse_notes: No SEBI or fraud action found. Promoter holding ~58.3%. Subsidiary Shri Green Agro Energies commissioned Phase-1 of a 5 TPD CBG plant at Bulandshahr in June 2026.
bull_case: FY26 revenue roughly doubled (~Rs 119 Cr) with ~20% pre-tax margin and ~25% ROE, on an essentially net-cash balance sheet
Order book ~Rs 345 Cr (~3x revenue) plus a ~Rs 650 Cr tender pipeline - visibility unusual for a company this small
CBG entry (5 TPD plant, Phase-1 live) is a real move from one-off contract revenue toward owned, recurring-off-take assets; India CBG / SATAT policy tailwind
Optionality from UAE expansion and adjacent water/power/renewable infra work
Very small base (~Rs 163 Cr mcap) - a successful execution of the order book plus CBG scale-up could re-rate materially
bear_case: CGD-pipeline EPC is low-moat, tender-driven and working-capital-heavy, with concentration in a handful of gas-utility customers
CBG contribution is negligible today; single small plant, execution and feedstock economics unproven
Sub-Rs 200 Cr SME - thin liquidity, limited disclosure, no analyst or forum scrutiny
Rapid revenue doubling off a tiny base can reverse just as fast if order inflow slows
Sovrenn datapoint (CBG commissioning) checks out against filings, but it is an early-stage adjacency, not yet an earnings driver
verdict_headline: Tiny CGD-pipeline EPC contractor with a real FY26 inflection (revenue ~2x, ~25% ROE, net-cash), an order book ~3x revenue and a genuine CBG step-up - thesis_fit 10x-in-2-3-years (UNCONFIRMED), conviction Low-Medium.
